verdicts.reason: A: the big quote mark that anchored the original has shrunk to a tiny glyph floating above the text, the left ~170px is dead space, and the logo's MONOGRAPH/GALLERY wordmark is shrunk and crowded until it is barely legible. Still, the quote and attribution share a left edge and read in order. B has all of A's problems and is worse: the attribution starts about 45px left of the quote, so nothing lines up, the quote mark floats over the middle of the line, and the logo wordmark is cut off at the bottom edge of the canvas (GALLERY is clipped), which breaks the brand.
